classification.difficultyReason: Identify opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse relative to theta, then substitute into the six taught ratio definitions.

content.prompt: Evaluate the six circular functions of angle $\theta$ for the triangle below.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with horizontal adjacent side 12, vertical opposite side 5, hypotenuse 13, theta inside the left vertex and a right-angle square at the bottom-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Relative to theta: opposite = 5, adjacent = 12, hypotenuse = 13; 5 squared plus 12 squared equals 13 squared.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; evaluated ratios belong in answers.

answer.worked:
The opposite side is $5$, the adjacent side is $12$ and the hypotenuse is $13$.

$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}=\frac{5}{13}\\\cos\theta&=\frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}=\frac{12}{13}\\\tan\theta&=\frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}=\frac{5}{12}\\\csc\theta&=\frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{opposite}}=\frac{13}{5}\\\sec\theta&=\frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{adjacent}}=\frac{13}{12}\\\cot\theta&=\frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{opposite}}=\frac{12}{5}\end{align*}$$
